integrity: A complete analytic proof is provided; reproducible symbolic and high-precision checks are supplementary, not a proof of infinite parameter families.
scientific_limitations: For general unequal widths the theorem classifies only the first-order weak-restart sign. The critical quadratic curvature and locally emerging optimizer assume equal layer widths; no global reset-rate optimum is claimed. Prior general renewal and coefficient-of-variation theories are credited; independent publication-priority audit has not occurred.
title: A sharp heterogeneity-induced restart frontier for two-layer Brownian escape
